records.text: Victor Marx says the Kurdistan government officially invited his organization into Iraq to help people who had been held captive by the Islamic State.
records.speaker: Victor Marx

appearances.snippet: And the purpose was we had an invitation by the Kurdistan government. We had access placement and an official invitation to go in to help those who had been held captive by ISIS.

verification.notes: ATP activity in Iraq is independently documented, but no Kurdistan Regional Government invitation naming Marx or ATP was located. Current reporting says the Kurdish government did not respond to requests to verify his operational claims.

records.text: Victor Marx says his team rescued a mother who had been held captive by the Islamic State for nine years and had two children in captivity, after planning the mission for six months and executing it in five days.
records.speaker: Victor Marx

appearances.snippet: that was a rescue of a mom who had been held captive nine years. She was kidnapped as a teenager, had two children inside of captivity of ISIS, and we planned a mission for six months, executed in five days. ... It's documented, and she's back home with her family.

verification.notes: Marx has repeated a similar rescue account in other interviews, but current searches found no name, partner record, government record, or independent report establishing the nine-year captivity, two children, six-month planning period, or five-day execution.
